title: API: the Inventory Value report leaves out an untracked part and agrees with the screen totals
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com, S2 shop. Location Staging Lethbridge. Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. API replay from Chrome DevTools against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location (Copy as fetch from a request of the logged-in session, then edit method, path and body). QAPL-B1 is tracked with stock at Staging Lethbridge. No negative bins at this location (the negative-bin parts QAPL-N1…N5 are not stocked here; SV-10380 netting also moves totals). After the test turn QAPL-B1's tracking back on at Staging Lethbridge.
custom_steps:
1. Reports > Inventory Value (/reports/inventory-value) for today; note the QAPL-B1 row and the totals row (row_iv_totals).
  2. Replay GET /api/reporting/reports/inventory-value for today (copied from the Network tab).
  3. Open QAPL-B1 on /parts/inventory, switch Track quantities and cost of goods off and Save.
  4. Run the Inventory Value report for today again.
  5. Replay GET /api/reporting/reports/inventory-value for today again.
custom_expected:
1. QAPL-B1 is listed with its quantity and value.
  2. 200; QAPL-B1 is in the response and the totals equal the screen's.
  3. Saved without a prompt; QAPL-B1's Total Qty reads Not Tracked.
  4. QAPL-B1 is not listed; the totals drop by exactly QAPL-B1's row figures from step 1.
  5. 200; QAPL-B1 is not in the response and the totals equal the screen totals from step 4.
